description: "My grandfather told my dad as he was dying, 'don't put me at the VA.'" Arizona State Senator Wendy Rogers discusses the extended timeframes required to process veteran medical records and determine disability ratings, emphasizing the necessity of allowing veterans access to non-VA healthcare providers.

title: AZ Senator Wendy Rogers relates personal military experience to VA healthcare delays | Wendy Rogers
